state_model.implemented_progression: intro -> sector -> q0 -> intended auto-advance -> gate -> results
state_model.observed_progression: intro (visually clipped CTA) -> sector -> q0 -> first option selected -> runtime exception/stall
state_model.persistence: none; answers and sector are in-memory; UTMs use sessionStorage
state_model.scoring: 12 equally weighted ordinal answers scored 1-4; two questions per dimension; tier cutoffs by mean: >=3.5 PIONEERING, >=2.5 EMERGING, >=1.5 DEVELOPING, else EARLY STAGE
